basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Anatomy, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi, is filling two contractual posts – Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical) – under an ICMR-funded research project (Project Code: I-2056). The tenure is initially 6 months, and the salary is as per ICMR Guidelines. Candidates with a first class Master's degree in Life Science or a related field (with experience as specified for each post) should email a detailed CV to [email protected], mentioning the post in the subject, by 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Mention the post applied for in the email subject – Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) or Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical).
Send the email by the last date for submission of CV, 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: This vacancy notice, dated 16 November 2026, is issued by Dr. Prabhakar Tiwari, Department of Anatomy, AIIMS, New Delhi – 110029. The posts are contractual positions under an ICMR-funded research project with Project Code I-2056, based in the Department of Anatomy at AIIMS, New Delhi. The notice is printed in English and Hindi.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own qualification and age. The notice's Age column shows 40 years for Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) and 35 years for Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical); it does not print a date for counting age or any age relaxation. Essential qualification: First class Master's degree in relevant subject/field (Life Science/ Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Genetics/Biotechnology/ Neuroscience/Neurobiology/Molecular Medicine/Biomedical Science) with three years' experience or PhD. Experience: Experience in cell culture preferably neuronal and microglial cell lines, co-culturing and rescue experiments, miRNA and siRNA, molecular biology, flow cytometry and LC-MS, PCR/RT-PCR etc. Age: 40 years Essential qualification: Three Years Graduate in relevant subject/field + Three Years experience or First-class Master's degree in Life Science/ Genetics/Human Genetics/Molecular Genetics/Biotechnology/ Neuroscience/Neurobiology/Molecular Medicine/Biomedical Science. Experience: Experience in cell culture, molecular and clinical research work. Note: PhD aspirants are encouraged to apply. Age: 35 years Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: For both posts, the salary is "As per ICMR Guidelines"; the notice prints no amount and does not mention HRA or other allowances. Both are contractual positions under the ICMR-funded project. The tenure for each post is initially 6 months, with extension subject to satisfactory performance, and project requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV. Email the CV to [email protected] . Mention the post applied for in the email subject – Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) or Project Technical Support-III (Non-Medical). Send the email by the last date for submission of CV, 30 November 2026 . Documents named in the notice: Detailed CV

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The interview may be conducted online/offline. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The notice does not mention an interview date.
